items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Thank you, Milton, and thank you for ever being associated with me.

ctx.x: That's right. That's right. The world is separated, Milton, if you want to know the truth, and music describes the world. There's no togetherness in the world. People don't dance together no more, They dances separately. Everybody's doing their own thing. So how are you going to have togetherness in music?
Thank you, Butter. I'm so glad --
